localization.name: Kalita Wave 25:400
localization.short_description: A dose-multiple pour schedule finishing at 400g water

steps.description_source: Dose in 25 grams of coffee, medium-fine grind, and give the filter a rinse first with water around 93 degrees Celsius. We're using a Gabi Dripmaster underneath today -- just a heads up, that thing's got a 120 milliliter reservoir built in, so keep an eye on it if you're brewing anything bigger.
steps.description_template: Dose in 25 grams of coffee, medium-fine grind, and give the filter a rinse first with water around 93 degrees Celsius. We're using a Gabi Dripmaster underneath today -- just a heads up, that thing's got a 120 milliliter reservoir built in, so keep an eye on it if you're brewing anything bigger.

steps.description_source: Start your timer and bloom up to three times the dose, so about 75 grams, nice and even, and let it sit for a bit.
steps.description_template: Start your timer and bloom up to three times the dose, so about 75 grams, nice and even, and let it sit for a bit.

steps.description_source: Once that settles, start your second pour, pouring in slow circles -- you'll pass through five times the dose, around 125 grams, on your way -- and keep going up to eight times the dose, 200 grams even.
steps.description_template: Once that settles, start your second pour, pouring in slow circles -- you'll pass through five times the dose, around 125 grams, on your way -- and keep going up to eight times the dose, 200 grams even.

steps.description_source: Then keep pouring in slow circles, roughly 5 grams a second, until you reach the full 400 grams.
steps.description_template: Then keep pouring in slow circles, roughly 5 grams a second, until you reach the full 400 grams.

steps.description_source: From there just let it draw down completely.
steps.description_template: From there just let it draw down completely.
